title: Hi r/themallworld I think I found my people….been hunting for answers to my dreams for years
content: Found this sub this morning and immediately have been searching “dream” in my texts and can find so many between my best friend and sister describing EXACTLY these places we all go to. The maps, the photos, it’s all the same. I thought experiencing “mall world” in and of itself was mind blowing enough but now I know there’s more of you 🫠
